summary.text: Senfronia Thompson is a Democratic state representative who has represented Texas House District 141 since 1983 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously represented District 89 from 1973 to 1983 and has worked as an attorney and public school teacher.

paragraphs.text: Senfronia Thompson has worked as an attorney and a public school teacher and sits on the advisory board of the United Negro College Fund.
Thompson served in the Texas House from 1973 to 1983 representing District 89, and has represented District 141 since 1983.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the State Affairs, Licensing & Administrative Procedures, and Redistricting committees.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Julie Hunt is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
